description: Send text and optional file attachments to a Telegram chat. Supports reply-to (including forum topics and channel discussion groups), parse_mode: classic markdown/html/auto (entities) or rich (Rich Message document; dialect auto-detected). parse_mode=rich cannot be combined with files. File attachments as http(s) URLs, local paths, or data: URIs. When files are provided, the message text becomes a caption. For channel posts with reply_to_id, automatically posts in the linked discussion group. Success: dict with message_id, date, chat, text, status='sent', and sender info (rich messages also set rich=true and rich_format). Error: dict with ok=false and error string. Use send_message to create new messages; use edit_message to modify existing ones. Use send_message_to_phone when targeting a phone number instead of a chat_id.  Full documentation: https://github.com/leshchenko1979/fast-mcp-telegram/blob/main/docs/Tools-Reference.md

chat_id.description: Target chat: numeric id (e.g. -100…), username without @, or 'me' for Saved Messages.

files.description: List of attachment URLs, local paths, or data URIs (one or more strings). data: URIs (data:<mime>;base64,<payload>) work in all server modes; local paths work in stdio mode only.

message.description: Message text. When sending files, used as caption.

parse_mode.description: 'markdown'/'html'/'auto': classic entity formatting (auto detects). 'rich': Telegram Rich Message document; dialect auto-detected (known HTML tags outside code → rich HTML, else rich markdown). Default is 'auto'. parse_mode='rich' cannot be combined with files.

reply_to_id.description: Telegram message id to reply to. For forums, topic root id; for channel posts, post id (may create a comment). Omit for a new top-level message.

name: send_message
title: Send message
